prompt: Before deciding whether to take the breath test, did the defendant ask to contact anyone? Select all that apply.
options: A relative or friend (not an attorney)

prompt: If a relative or friend was requested, what was the stated or apparent purpose of that request?
options: To get advice on whether to take the test, or what to do (defense-related)
Purely personal — e.g. arranging bail, notifying family, emotional support — no defense-related purpose apparent
N/A — only an attorney was requested
Request was denied outright — no opportunity to contact anyone was given
An opportunity was given, but the defendant was not able to communicate privately
An opportunity was given, but not within a reasonable time given the circumstances (e.g. the person could have arrived or advised further, but wasn't given the time to)
A reasonable opportunity to contact and consult was given

prompt: Roughly what was the timeline — when was the request made, when was contact made (if any), and when was the test administered?
